description: Initial public-only reference. Independent analytic checks live in test_public_demo.py. Exact typed model snapshots cover two and seven fictional planes; no private inputs or oracle.

cost_basis.value: Explicit thermal bills; embedded electrical energy is already in the household electricity bill

direct_bill_policy.value: No variable share inferred; direct-bill savings require explicit disconnection

range_definition.value: Min–max across all historical weather years; markers are medians, not probability or confidence intervals.

items.value: Modeled month/hour load; no intrahour peaks or inferred heating.

replacement_requirements.value: Embedded replacement requires an identified, aligned separated electrical artifact.

aggregation.value: Coherent single-weather analogue (median PV yield); AC-equivalent flows and stored delta satisfy PV=direct+charge+export, load=direct+delivered+grid, and charge-delivered=storage_losses+storage_delta

representative_basis.value: All historical weather years; candidate and Self-Use paired by year

reasoning.value: Each weather year repeats over life with annual aging. Cash flows separate PV against identical future load from conversion package against historic electric+gas baseline. Historical gas annualization uses a flat August-regulated-rate approximation.

definition.value: Solar-only equity cash flows allocate loan principal and debt service proportionally: solar_loan_principal = min(principal, solar_capex), with yearly debt service scaled by solar_loan_ratio = solar_loan_principal / total_principal. Year 0 equity outlay is -solar_capex + solar_loan_principal (initial solar equity = solar_capex - solar_loan_principal), and yearly flows deduct allocated debt service. When package loan is selected (loan_include_electrification=True), total principal covers combined solar and conversion capex up to borrowing limits, allocating debt service without double deducting capex or principal.
